title: MEA electrophysiology workflow parameters
description: Shared launch parameters for original and named-stage callers. Scientific settings remain in nested --params_file JSON. Runtime image defaults live in container_images.json.

ecephys_path.description: Input NWB/session directory for the original caller or preprocessing/all.

input_bundle.description: Verified local bundle for an independent downstream stage.

unit_id.description: Stable identity for a named-stage input.

units_file.description: JSON list of named-stage inputs and metadata.

params_file.description: Nested scientific capsule JSON; distinct from Nextflow -params-file.

runmode.description: Existing caller mode; fast retains its original capsule overrides.

n_jobs.description: Scientific worker count; -1 retains the existing all-worker behavior.

container_images.description: Per-invocation runtime overrides. Omitted roles inherit container_images.json; local, NERSC and NRP receive the same explicit task settings.

report_container_image.description: Existing report-only override; takes precedence over container_images.analysis.

process_resources.description: Per-process resource maps, independent of scientific settings and other invocations.

nrp_resources.description: Existing NRP resource fallback below explicit invocation resources.
